# Comparison carrier binding

Independently authored opaque provider for a covariant list, two integer bounds,
and a contravariant callback returning Integer. It returns an independently
selected int, rather than assuming any search result. Class and method formals
share a name while retaining distinct bounds and declarations. Frozen JVM
observers check mutable list values, callbacks, unboxing, partial effects,
initialization, exact exceptions, metadata, and every emitted Java file.
